title: Home and activity
body: Use these shortcuts to choose profile preferences, filter suggestions, or open your rating history.

title: Discovery mode
body: Choose how people are matched before you review cards. Changing this mode changes the suggestions and available search fields.

title: Individual profiles
body: Browse one profile at a time and compare it with your preferences. Use this when you want to decide separately for each person.

title: Friends in common
body: Find suggestions connected through mutual friends. The extra search fields help narrow the list to people in the same social circle.

title: Inside your network
body: Browse people connected to your existing network. This view helps you discover profiles through relationships you already share.

title: Outside your network
body: Explore profiles beyond your current connections. Use this view when you want to broaden the people you can discover.

title: Profile filters
body: Set interests and profile criteria to focus the suggestions you see. The filter badge shows when criteria are active, so you can tell why the list is narrower.

title: Rating history
body: The Ratings shortcut on Home opens your rating activity. From there, the rating group menu lets you review likes you sent, Received, matched, or marked as met.

title: Suggested people
body: These cards show people in your current discovery view. Badges summarize activity, while the card controls open photos, Profiles, and rating actions.

title: Switch profile photos
body: The photo is divided into one clickable section per image: three photos give thirds, four give quarters. Tap a section to select that photo without opening a popup.

title: Open full profile
body: Use the eye button to see the person’s profile, Experience, and other details. Your current discovery list stays available behind the profile popup.

title: Affinity slider
body: Move the slider from 1 to 10 to express how strongly this profile fits you. The chosen value is saved when you press Go.

title: Fine-tune the rating
body: Open the number and arrow button beside Go. Adjust the individual criteria; their average sets your rating. The main slider moves them together. Close the panel, then confirm with Go.

title: Save and go to the next profile
body: Go is a button: it saves the selected affinity value and advances to the next suggested profile. Adjust the slider before pressing it.
